metadata.description: Jody's portable pro dev skill stack

plugins.name: pro-core
plugins.description: Core dev skills: brainstorming, TDD, debug, planning, worktrees, subagent-driven dev

plugins.name: pro-quality
plugins.description: Quality gate skills: requesting + receiving code review, verification-before-completion. Recommended companion: playwright from claude-plugins-official

plugins.name: pro-nextjs
plugins.description: Next.js stack marker; recommended companions: vercel + figma from claude-plugins-official

plugins.name: pro-design
plugins.description: Frontend design skills: design tokens, accessibility audit, motion system, typography scale

plugins.name: pro-testing
plugins.description: Testing stack marker (Vitest / Playwright / Storybook). Recommended companion: playwright from claude-plugins-official

plugins.name: pro-data
plugins.description: Data & auth stack marker (Drizzle / Prisma / Auth). Skills slot reserved for Phase 3 content

plugins.name: pro-spec
plugins.description: Spec-driven development marker (GitHub Spec Kit / specification-first workflows). Skills slot reserved for Phase 3 content

plugins.name: pro-starter
plugins.description: Meta-plugin: installs the full pro dev stack (core + quality + nextjs + design)
